name: Sekh
desc:
Sekh is Vesperian NPC. He is a Hive Scout.

His dialogue gives insight to the region of [The Aratel Sea](location:the_aratel_sea) and its conflicts, mainly involving [The Hive](faction:the_hive), [The Central Authority](faction:the_central_authority), [Etrea](faction:etrea) and [The Children of Navae](faction:the_children_of_navae), as well as the inhabitants of Meteor Isle, especially [Eres](entity:eres), whom he speaks fondly of.
additional_info:
-   Sekh's racial variant appears to be Plackart
-   Naktigonis wrote the dialogue for Eres.
-   Some players speculate that there may be a romance between Eres and Sekh based on their unique dialogue, but this has not been confirmed.
-   Eres and Sekh are stated to both be gay.
